description: This file defines validators for handling discriminators in Kubernetes API validation, including tag validation, type validation, and generating validation rules based on discriminator groups and members.

classes.name: discriminatorGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of discriminator members with associated rules and a discriminator member.

classes.name: fieldMemberRules
classes.description: Holds validation rules for a specific member within a discriminator group.

classes.name: memberRule
classes.description: Defines a validation rule with a value and associated validations for a discriminator member.

classes.name: discriminatorTagValidator
classes.description: Validator for the discriminator tag, managing discriminator groups and their validation logic.

classes.name: memberTagValidator
classes.description: Validator for member tags, associating validation rules with discriminator values.

classes.name: discriminatorFieldValidator
classes.description: Validator for discriminator fields, generating validation rules based on discriminator groups.

methods.name: GetValidations
methods.description: Generates validation rules for discriminator fields based on discriminator groups and member rules.

methods.name: generateMemberFieldValidation
methods.description: Creates validation functions for a member field within a discriminator group, handling value conversions and validation rule assembly.

methods.name: getForbiddenValidation
methods.description: Returns validation rules that forbid certain types of fields based on their type.

methods.name: convertDiscriminatorValue
methods.description: Converts a string discriminator value to its appropriate typed Go literal based on the discriminator's type.
